title: fix: add Polli harness request example
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds an `opencode` example to the existing Polli harness request schema.
- Lets API-doc generation produce a runnable JSON curl body for `/account/polli/harness-on`.
- Leaves runtime validation and endpoint behavior unchanged.

Tested: Biome, `git diff --check`, and Zod JSON-schema example emission.

gist.headline: A curl body takes shape
gist.blurb: Polli’s harness docs get an `opencode` example. The curl request has something concrete to send.
gist.summary: Added an `opencode` example to the Polli harness request schema so generated API docs can include a runnable JSON curl body for `/account/polli/harness-on`, without changing endpoint behavior.
gist.impact: Developers get a copyable `opencode` request example for `/account/polli/harness-on`; runtime validation stays the same.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli at a cozy terminal, handing the Monitor Robot a small JSON request card labeled `opencode`. A code-plant beside the terminal ties the documentation example to the garden setting; the card represents a usable curl body, not a new endpoint.
gist.image_prompt: In a cozy pixel art garden shed, Polli hands a tiny `opencode` JSON request card to a delighted CRT-headed Monitor Robot beside a terminal and a sprouting code-plant. The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears tiny coder glasses, stays small-to-medium in the scene, and is strictly pixel art, never realistic. Cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with prominent lime green (#ecf874), warm cream, and dark purple (#110518) details.
